meta.time_precision: 24 fps resample; every time in this analysis is approximate within 1/24 s (0.0417 s). Nothing here is a recovered keyframe or a source ease.
meta.presentation_chrome: The 1008x720 frame is a presentation canvas: a light #f9f9f9 ground with a Hook / Demo / End Result / CTA segmented chip bar and a red playhead along the bottom. The film is the black 16:9 inner panel at x 61-947, y 62-558 (886x496 px, measured on frame-1.50 / frame-8.50 with the 10% grid). Every citation, fill and type size in this spec refers to that panel; fills are divided by 496, its shorter side. The chip labels are an annotation track that matches the film's acts (the playhead enters Demo at ~7.4 s, End Result at ~15.4 s, CTA at ~19.0 s); the chrome is not replicated.
meta.use_when: A 26 s product-demo spot on a flat black bed: chat request -> real editor UI -> one glide into an agent panel -> typed prompt -> streamed reply and linear count-up -> changes list -> chat payoff -> two CTA lines word by word -> logo; joined almost entirely by one-frame cuts (four plain, four reframes on the same surface, two leftward throws) with lateral slide exits/entrances; use it for a fixed-lens, cut-driven demo with typed prompts and text payoffs.

pacing.seams_on_onsets: 2 of 11 cut/throw seams within 60 ms of an onset (5.792 at +58 ms, 15.417 at -17 ms) against a chance level of ~3.5 of 11 at 2.68 onsets/s - the film is not cut to the beat; four more are near misses at +73..+95 ms (10.958, 12.042, 13.125, 19.167). Two settles land on hits: the glide settles at 9.667 (+13 ms) and the 'Grow' throw settles at 17.625 (-25 ms). The bed's accented hits repeat every ~1.09 s (8.85, 9.94, 11.04 ... 21.96); only 15.4 has a cut on it.
pacing.typing_cadence: one typing beat, ~22 chars/s average in bursts: an initial ~10-char burst within 2 frames of the click (8.917-8.958), then ~1 char per frame (24 chars/s) with single-frame pauses to 9.833; a 0.17 s pause; '@homepag' at ~48 chars/s (10.0-10.167); picker resolves to a chip at 10.292; a 0.2 s pause; 'acros' at ~12 chars/s (10.5-10.917). pacing.stagger_spacing: Changes rows 0.125 s apart (3 frames); CTA words 0.375 s (Grow -> faster), 0.125 s (With -> the brand), 0.333 s (the brand -> Agents); streamed reply words 0.04-0.08 s; hook roll words 0.10 -> 0.37 s lengthening

do_not: Do not rebuild the presentation chrome (light canvas, Hook / Demo / End Result / CTA chips, red playhead): the film is the black 16:9 inner panel only.

Exact replica of the camera: the lens travels once (a 0.58 s power2.inOut glide at 9.083); every other reframe is a one-frame cut. Do not add pushes, drifts, re-aims or settles the strips do not show.
Do not soften any join: there is no crossfade, blur-dissolve, dip or whip anywhere; the only cross-cut motion is a lateral slide.
Do not ease the count-up: it is linear, ~10 per frame, 1 -> 286 in 1.0 s, and stops dead.
Do not animate chat messages in: they cut in whole after typing dots; only the first chat header and the CTA words slide.
Do not keep the cursor after the click at 8.875: it vanishes on the click frame and everything after is agent motion; no cursor in the macro shots.
Do not cut to the beat: 2 of 11 seams sit on an onset (below the ~3.5 chance level); the settles at 9.667 and 17.625 are the two intentional-looking hits.
Do not slow the reply stream: ~14 words/s, each word one frame at half brightness then white.
Do not extend, fade or animate the end card: 4.28 s static logo with the bed stopping under it and a hard end at the last frame.
Do not use the brand colour as a fill or add glows and grain: the film is white on black; the only chroma is the product UI and the hero photograph.
Do not re-centre the CTA line when a word lands: later words attach to the right of the first with a small slide; the line drifts, it does not jump.
evidence_rules: Every seam and landing cites sheet + tile(s). A row with evidence:[] is a guess, carries confidence:"low", and is flagged by validate-spec.mjs. Sheet ids: c-NNN (4 fps composition, tiles 1-30), f-NNN (24 fps full, tiles 1-48), w-<t> (24 fps strip, tiles 1-N per windows/index.json), overview (cells 1-24). Tile numbers are per sheet: tile = badge frame - 30 x (sheet - 1) on c-sheets, - 48 x (sheet - 1) on f-sheets; map.txt resolves any cell. note fields are allowed on every row and are rendered in the briefs.
